basic_info.description: Discover the untapped potential of this coveted Bernal Heights fixer, perfectly positioned on the desirable western slope! Just moments from vibrant Mission and Cortland corridors, this cherished homeheld by the same family for generationsis brimming with opportunity. With its prime location near transit, shopping, and top-rated dining, this property is a rare canvas awaiting your vision. Bring your creativity and transform this classic residence into a stunning modern masterpiece. Offered as-isdon't miss your chance to create something truly special!
